titles.romaji: Chiba Pedal: Yowamushi Pedal to Manabu Jitensha Koutsuu Anzen
titles.native: ちばペダル ～弱虫ペダルと学ぶ自転車交通安全～

description:
A set of six short stories featuring the members of Sohoku Cycling Club that tell about the importance of safe driving, following traffic rules and properly maintaining your bike.

(Source: Singan on AniDB)
